scenes.kicker: CASE STUDY 2 OF 3 · DATA ENGINEERING · SUPPLY CHAIN
scenes.title: Supply Chain Control Tower
scenes.sub: A 90-store retail network is missing its service target. **Buy more stock, or move what it already has?**

scenes.caption: On-time-in-full delivery sits at **90.4%** against a **95%** target.
Every region misses. Split into its two failures, **short-shipping, not lateness**, is the bigger one.
Over 13 weeks the replenishment gap grew **15.2%** while stock on hand barely moved. The stock is in the wrong place.
**$96,330** of the gap is a transfer between warehouses, not a purchase order.

scenes.source: PYSPARK · DELTA LAKE · RUN AS A DATABRICKS JOB · BENCHMARKED AT 10M ROWS
guards: schema contract stops drift before Bronze
scenes.caption: A medallion pipeline with three defences, under an eight-page Power BI control tower.

scenes.title: supply-chain-control-tower — real output, recorded for this video
scenes.caption: Each defence is proven by breaking the data on purpose: drift halts the run, bad rows are quarantined, a failure blocks publishing.
Suppliers are scored on what they did: **18 of 24** sit in a different band than their contract says.
A live studio turns a disruption into owned actions: in the Mexico scenario, **13 SKUs** have no qualified alternate.
